name: Build to-do sync help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Build to-do sync plugin: the page, the name prompt and the settings.
author: Brett

entries.title: Build to-do lists
entries.text: Every build is a list in the AmberX to-do manager (Builds › category › name) whose items are the orchestrator's steps, ticked off live. This page shows the sync state, ticks waiting for your OK, builds still to name and every mirrored build.

entries.title: Sync now
entries.text: Re-checks every build against its to-do list right away and writes what differs. Store events do this by themselves; use it after a change you can't see yet.

entries.title: Dry run
entries.text: Plans the sync and tells you how many items would change, without writing anything.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: You ticked (or unticked) this item in the to-do manager. Approve changes the step in the Build orchestrator the same way.

entries.title: Deny
entries.text: Puts the to-do item back the way the step is. The step does not change.

entries.title: Confirm name
entries.text: Saves the short name and category of this build. The name is what you reference the build by everywhere: the to-do manager, the Build manager and chat.

entries.title: Open the prompt
entries.text: Opens the Name this build dialog for every build whose name or category is still a suggestion.

entries.title: Later
entries.text: Closes the prompt; the build keeps its suggested name until you confirm it, and the prompt won't reopen for it in this browser.

entries.title: Close
entries.text: Closes the dialog.

entries.title: Short name
entries.text: The name you reference the build by (48 characters at most). The suggestion comes from the build's title; change it to whatever you'd say out loud.

entries.title: Category
entries.text: One of Plugin, Plugin extension, Add-on, Framework, App, Feature or Module. The to-do list sits under this category; build lists group and filter by it.

entries.title: Sync build to-do lists
entries.text: On: the lists follow the builds. Off: builds keep running, the lists stop syncing and a note on the Builds list says since when.

entries.title: Prompt me to name a new build
entries.text: When a build appears without a confirmed name, the Name this build dialog opens once for it.

entries.title: Keep finished builds in Done for
entries.text: How many days a completed build stays as a done list under Builds › Done before it leaves the to-do manager.

entries.title: Full reconcile every
entries.text: Store events sync at once; this timer re-checks every list and item as a safety net and refreshes the sync note.

entries.title: Check the store file every
entries.text: How often the plugin looks at the builds store file for a change an event may have missed.

entries.title: Console link base
entries.text: The console address the to-do items link back to (https only). Empty = the default console.

entries.title: Save timings
entries.text: Saves the day, minute and second settings above. The two switches save by themselves.

entries.title: Build to-do sync settings
entries.text: On/off, the name prompt, how long done builds stay, how often the plugin reconciles, and the console link base.

entries.title: Build to-do sync
entries.text: The plugin's settings tab under Settings → Plugins: on/off, the name prompt, how long done builds stay in Done, how often it reconciles, the console link base, and Install & uninstall.

entries.title: Name this build
entries.text: Prompts you for a build's short name and category when a new build appears without a confirmed one. The name is how you reference the build in the to-do manager, the Build manager and chat; edit the suggestion or keep it.

entries.title: Name a build…
entries.text: Opens the Name this build prompt for every build whose name or category is still a suggestion.

steps.say: This page is the bridge between the Build orchestrator and your to-do manager: one list per build, one item per step, ticked live.
Items you tick in the to-do manager wait here for your OK before the step changes.
New builds get a suggested name and category; confirm or change them here or in the prompt.
